2609.27558.title: ThaiTrees: Thai Syntactic Dependency Trees Across Domains
2609.27558.paper_summary: Studying syntactic patterns in naturally occurring language requires a large parsed corpus, but manual annotation is costly and difficult to scale. Thai has a manually annotated dependency treebank for training and evaluating parsers, but lacks a large automatically parsed corpus for quantitative syntactic research. We present ThaiTrees, a 342M-token corpus drawn from news, Wikipedia, spoken transcripts, and social media. We develop a reproducible pipeline for cleaning, processing, and parsing Thai text under the Universal Dependencies framework. The resulting corpus makes grammatical relations searchable and supports the study of syntactic distributions. We release a frequency lexicon and CoNLL-U parses in machine-readable formats suitable for both AI-assisted and conventional programmatic analysis.
2609.27558.paper_summary_zh: 研究自然語言中的句法模式需要一個大型的解析語料庫，但手動標註成本高且難以擴展。泰語擁有一個手動標註的依賴樹庫，用於訓練和評估解析器，但缺乏一個大型的自動解析語料庫以進行定量句法研究。我們提出了ThaiTrees，這是一個由新聞、維基百科、口語轉錄和社交媒體提取的342M-token語料庫。我們在通用依賴框架下開發了一個可重複的流程，用於清理、處理和解析泰語文本。生成的語料庫使語法關係可搜尋，並支持句法分佈的研究。我們發布了一個頻率詞典和CoNLL-U解析，並提供適合AI輔助和傳統程序分析的機器可讀格式。
